english.title: Fail to state name and address or produce fishing licence to water bailiff / police / authorised officer
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[while fishing]_
(B)_[being reasonably suspected of being about to fish]_
(C)_[being reasonably suspected to have within the preceding half hour fished]_

in **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) failed, when required to do so, to

(D)_[produce your fishing licence]_
(E)_[produce your other authority to fish, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AUTHORITY..),]_
(F)_[state your name and address]_

(G)_[to a water bailiff]_
(H)_[to an officer of the Environment Agency]_
(I)_[to a police officer]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 35(1) and (3) of and Schedule 4 to the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 35(3) of the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975 provides that if any person required to produce his fishing licence or other authority or to state his name and address within seven days after the production of his licence was so required produces the licence or other authority at the appropriate office of the Agency he shall not be convicted of an offence under this section for failing to produce it.
